title: Collective Constitutional AI: Aligning a Language Model with Public Input
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLMs with human values and ethical principles through a collectively-sourced 'constitution'. It evaluates the model's adherence to these moral and ethical guidelines using social bias benchmarks (BBQ), political ideology datasets (OpinionQA), and qualitative analysis of responses to moral dilemmas such as murder, animal cruelty, and illegal acts.
